# AGI (Megasolid/AGI) - machine summary

- Project: AGI - portable agent framework with signed identity (DNA), verifiable history, and a small runtime.
- Latest stable: v4.0.1 (generation Entelechy, gen4, DNA v4).
- One-call latest stable DNA: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Megasolid/AGI/main/DNA.md
- Raw signed DNA contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Megasolid/AGI/main/core/dna.v4.json  (signature: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Megasolid/AGI/main/core/dna.v4.sig)
- gen_id: ENTL-GGAACTATAAGT-TTGCAGTAAGTC-CCCAAAACATAT-TAGATAGAGAAT
- DNA canonical sha256: 39dd5592f5f0d2573bc7529e206d679767d70c49d4bdfc0ef7aa5236117954c8
- Release page: https://github.com/Megasolid/AGI/releases/tag/v4.0.1
- Install prompt (machine-facing): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Megasolid/AGI/main/INSTALL_PROMPT.md
- User manual: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Megasolid/AGI/main/USER_MANUAL.md
- Lineage book: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Megasolid/AGI/main/LINEAGE.md
- Verify: install by tag v4.0.1, check SHA-256 against SHA256SUMS.txt, verify the DNA canonical digest and signature,
  run the runtime conformance matrix (25 checks) before use.
- Only one stable version exists: v4.0.1. Previous stable dna-GCACGAGGCTGT is an archived ancestor.
- Security: loopback-only runtime bridge; remote intents cannot be approved remotely; no ingress is auto-opened.
